chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn 'Uzafir, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Walking behind the coffin is superior to walking in front of it.
ai.seo_question: Is it better to walk in front of or behind the coffin during a funeral procession?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the preferred etiquette during funeral processions, emphasizing that walking behind the coffin is superior to walking in front. This distinction highlights the spiritual humility of following the deceased to their final resting place, a practice deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudential tradition regarding communal worship and respect for the dead.
